faq.question: Why choose a wireless neckband over true wireless (TWS) earbuds?
faq.answer: Wireless neckbands offer significantly longer continuous battery life (30 to 40 hours versus 6 to 8 hours for TWS earbuds without their case), lower risk of dropping or losing an earbud during workouts or commutes, and magnetic instant connect/disconnect features.

faq.question: What driver size is ideal in budget wireless neckbands?
faq.answer: Driver sizes in budget neckbands typically range from 10mm to 13.4mm. Larger drivers (12.4mm to 13.4mm, like those in the OnePlus Bullets Z2 and realme Buds Wireless 3 Neo) generally produce deeper sub-bass and wider sound output without distortion at moderate volumes.

faq.question: What does an IPX5 or IPX7 rating mean for workout use in India?
faq.answer: IPX5 protects against low-pressure water jets and heavy sweat, making it well-suited for gym sessions and light drizzle. IPX7 (found on the boAt Rockerz 255 Pro+) offers immersion resistance up to 1 metre for 30 minutes, providing extra durability against intense workouts and monsoon rain.
